title: The Story Pillow on the Rug
youtube_title: The Story Pillow on the Rug | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making room at the table is a kind of abundance.
summary: At a ferry bench with a folded blanket, Vera sees that a story pillow big enough to share will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Vera makes a smaller, even share so Arun is included, and Miss Dalca lets the choice stand without a speech.
